topics: small-scale adventurous discovery without epic bombast
prompt: Compose an original complete 30-second instrumental cue for small-scale adventurous discovery without epic bombast. Instruments: staccato strings, French horn, timpani, harp. 128 BPM in 4/4. Motif: a clipped falling fifth answered by two repeated notes. Start the hook and beat immediately; maintain a clear pulse and concise two-bar phrases. One fresh timbral answer halfway through. Keep the groove throughout, then a decisive tonic ending during the last second with a very short natural decay. No slow intro, long outro, riser, silence or fade-out. Mobile-speaker-friendly bass. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. No imitation of any artist, song, film, game or brand.

description.en: A lively and grand orchestral piece with a big band/swing influence, featuring prominent brass fanfares, woodwind melodies, and a driving rhythm section. It evokes a classic, celebratory, and slightly whimsical or cartoonish atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首活泼宏大的管弦乐曲，带有大乐队/摇摆乐风格，以突出的铜管乐号角、木管乐旋律和强劲的节奏部分为特色。它营造出一种经典、庆祝且略带异想天开或卡通般的氛围。
